issues.description: Missing `import sys` in numba/cpython/mathimpl.py and numba/np/math/mathimpl.py where sys.version_info is now referenced.
issues.detail: Both impl files introduce `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` guards, but the diff only adds `import sys` to mathdecl.py. If sys is not already imported at module top in these files, they will NameError at import time on every Python version. Verify and add the import where needed.

issues.description: Conditional registration in mathdecl.py rebinds Math_unary and has suspicious indentation/placement relative to the class body.
issues.detail: The `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11): Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` block is glued to the class with no separating blank line and rebinds the class name as a side effect of the decorator. The call should be a bare statement (not a reassignment), placed at clear module scope with proper spacing, so subsequent references to Math_unary are unambiguous.

issues.description: Inconsistent version-gating idioms: source uses raw sys.version_info while tests use PYVERSION; unify on the project's existing constant.
issues.detail: numba.core.utils.PYVERSION is the canonical version predicate (used in the test). The three new source-side gates bypass it and use raw sys.version_info >= (3, 11). Two spellings of the same fact is incidental complexity and forces future Python-version bumps to be audited in two notations. Use PYVERSION everywhere.

issues.description: Test inputs are copy-pasted from test_exp and do not exercise exp2-specific semantics or edge cases.
issues.detail: x_values = [-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2] contains a duplicated -2, includes negatives fed through unsigned integer types (uint16/32/64), and probes none of exp2's interesting points: integer powers (exact 2**n), 0, large values near overflow (~1024), denormals, inf/nan. Add targeted inputs and state the per-type input domain.

issues.description: The same version-gated registration fact is duplicated across three modules instead of expressed as data in one place.
issues.detail: "math.exp2 exists from Python 3.11" is encoded as three separate imperative branches in mathdecl, cpython/mathimpl, and np/math/mathimpl. A single PYVERSION-keyed registry of (name, intrinsic, min_version) — or a hasattr(math, 'exp2') check — would make adding future math functions one-line and avoid drift between sites.

issues.description: Release note file is missing a trailing newline and the body redundantly restates the title.
issues.detail: docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst ends with `\ No newline at end of file`, the RST underline length is fragile relative to the title, and the body just repeats the title. Add the trailing newline, verify the underline length, and either trim or meaningfully extend the body.

synthesis.summary: The panel reaches strong consensus that this is a small, correctly-shaped feature with sloppy execution that needs another pass before merge. Two P0 defects dominate: `sys` is referenced in both mathimpl.py files without a visible `import sys` (NameError at import time), and the conditional registration in mathdecl.py rebinds Math_unary with suspect placement relative to the class body. Beyond that, three files use raw `sys.version_info` while the test uses the project's existing `PYVERSION` constant — pick one. Test inputs were cloned from test_exp without exercising exp2-specific semantics (integer powers, overflow, edge cases) and include negatives for unsigned types. Release note hygiene (missing newline, redundant body) is trivial but should be fixed.
